column1: # Covers Finnish-origin / Finnish-headquartered brands: Nokia and telecom, games and studios (Supercell, Rovio,
# Remedy and their titles), Moomin, design and homeware (Marimekko, Iittala, Arabia, Fiskars, Artek), forest,
# energy and industrial companies, food and confectionery (Fazer, Valio, Paulig), beer and spirits, retail
# (Kesko, S Group), banks and insurers, media, apps and tech, sports gear, fashion, cosmetics, airlines,
# Hangul: Korean market names first (노키아, 마리메코, 이딸라, 피스카스, 핀에어, 무민), else Korean media usage,
# else a Finnish-reading transcription (no official Korean rules for Finnish; geminates written plainly as in
# 마리메코); initialisms read as English letters.
# Sources: first pass (793 entries) own knowledge. Second pass consulted English Wikipedia "List of companies of
# Finland", "Category:Finnish brands" and Category: Food and drink companies / Food brands / Breweries /
# Drink companies / Retail companies / Supermarkets / Clothing / Software / Video game companies /
# Manufacturing / Sporting goods / Boat builders / Restaurants of Finland, "Category:Video games developed in
# Finland", Finnish Wikipedia "Luokka:Suomalaiset panimot"; remaining second-pass entries (Nasdaq Helsinki
# listed companies, Fazer/Valio sub-brands, media, clubs) own knowledge. Hangul not checked against Korean sources.
